text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: She refuses to give up first place! It's Daiwaaaa... Scaaarlet!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
W-wowee! That three-way standoff was
absolute
fire!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy I was here to witness this! I
have a
feeling we just saw something
really special...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...I did it! I beat Vodka and Machan!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...
Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations. Sure enough, you got
away from
me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...But I can't claim it doesn't hurt.
That's
why I'd
like to say... let's do it again
sometime!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: All three of us.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Machan...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Good. Well, I'll see you again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The crowd showers Aston Machan in
applause as she walks toward the
runner's tunnel. As if
enraptured by it,
she looks up at the stands.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
You were so close, Machan. You were
awesome!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I never thought I'd see another
three-way
standoff like that! Thank you
so much!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: This beautiful sound. This beautiful view.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's always loveliest when those two are
around.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I've truly been blessed, with both
friends... and
rivals.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Thank you both.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Let's all do it again sometime.
Someplace.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It'll definitely be another great race
next
time.
